title: Colts will receive a sixth-round pick for Michael Pittman Jr. and a seventh-rounder

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Colts will receive a sixth-round pick for Michael Pittman Jr. and a seventh-rounder
sources.description: When word broke on Monday that the Colts and Steelers agreed on a trade that will send wide receiver Michael Pittman Jr. to Pittsburgh, there were not any details of the draft pick swap that would be part of the deal.
